name: Diageo Montgomery Manufacturing & Warehousing - Hope Hull AL

fieldNotes._general: Brand-new $415M facility, officially opened April 21, 2026. The latest available satellite imagery (Maxar) is from the construction phase: roofs partially installed, yards graded but unpaved, no finished gates/fences/docks/trailer lots visible. Location is confirmed with HIGH confidence, but most yard-classification fields cannot be reliably determined from construction-era imagery and are flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.location: Positively identified: 7000 Celebration Way, Hope Hull AL. Two large buildings under construction in a logistics park ~south of Montgomery off I-65, matching Diageo press releases and WSFA coverage of the 360,000 sq ft manufacturing + warehousing site.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Confirmed - two distinct large buildings on one campus: a manufacturing building (north) and a warehouse building (south).
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Estimated band 25-50 - a 360K sq ft warehousing operation typically has a substantial dock bank; the warehouse building's south/west face is the likely dock location, but doors are not yet built/visible. Low confidence.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Cannot confirm - no finished gate visible in construction imagery. Defaulted false but flagged uncertain; a new automated $415M plant may well install a controlled gate.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Cannot confirm from imagery - flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: 0 - no operational trailers in construction-era imagery (only construction equipment and material laydown).
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur visible entering the property; the site sits in a road-served logistics park.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Hope Hull AL - rural/edge-of-metro south of Montgomery, surrounded by farmland and woods. Rural.
fieldNotes.highlyAutomated: Press notes the facility uses robotics, automated blending, and five on-site AGVs - relevant operational context though not a classification field.

citations.claim: Diageo North America officially opened its new 360,000 sq ft manufacturing and warehousing facility in Montgomery AL (~$415M).
Local news covers Diageo's new Hope Hull facility opening April 21, 2026.

verification.rationale: Plant is OPERATIONAL as of April 21, 2026 (grand opening), not construction/future; self-operated Diageo manufacturing + warehousing.
